title: ws-ready-check-start (app to server)

scope.description: run: the joined participants of the run; session: the owner and the viewers of the Session.

description: Any member starts a ready check for a run or Session; the starter counts as ready. Only one check per scope and id can be open: starting another one while it is open is not an error, the server sends the current check to the requester again. A non-member (or an unknown or ended run or Session) gets error forbidden. Needs together_v1.
